channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
141 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 6 HRS

  • Fixed circuit system leaks and out‑of‑bounds errors, improving stability of power and automation setups.
  • Elevators now draw power from the correct battery slot, preventing unintended battery depletion.
  • Fuel generators’ auxiliary inputs no longer drain connected batteries when downstream demand is present.
  • HBHF sensors once again include “other” entities, restoring their full detection range.
  • Pregnant livestock now sit as a visual cue and their vitals are frozen, so they won’t starve while gestating.

NPC & AI

  • Fixed scientists not spawning in Underwater Labs, Cargo Ships, and Military Base.
  • Fixed cargo scientists being immobile and Scientist 2 crouch‑walking oddly on the Oilrig.
  • Fixed old scientists steering incorrectly; they now turn instantly.
  • Fixed NPCs getting stuck when a navmesh tile rebuilds while they are inside or crossing it, and ensured AI spawned before an independent navmesh is built can locate it.

World & Monuments

  • Fixed static chairs on the gas‑station roof now mountable.
  • Fixed monument blocker rendering (desks), balanced their health and resource rates, and added blockers to all monuments.
  • Fixed wind‑turbine sound looping when the turbine isn’t spinning.
  • Fixed Jungle Ziggurat water‑treatment tank to use a single mesh collider for better performance.

Vehicles & Weapons

  • Fixed catapult loaded‑ammo pooling bug and horse client pooling issues; cached vehicle owners are cleared when seats are pooled.
  • Fixed siege weapons resetting properly after use.
  • Reset helicopter rotor speed and animators on init to prevent odd behavior.
  • Fixed flamethrower third‑person flame offset and salvaged hammer model offset.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Fixed Darts leaderboard UI: removed zoom control, added streamer‑mode compatibility, and ensured persistence after server restarts.
  • Fixed colour picker now accepts pasted hex‑code inputs.
  • Fixed binocular glare bug caused by an inverted check.

Animals & Livestock

  • Added new livestock species (cows and sheep) with male/female prefabs and proper spawning.
  • Fixed livestock animals moving while sleeping; they now sit while pregnant and drop dung correctly.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 17
item.description:
48 development commits

Animals

  • Fixed the gender bug: livestock now spawn with the correct male/female distribution instead of all being female.
  • Added a breeding state machine, enabling animals to breed as intended.
  • Introduced a Bull prefab, so bulls now appear in the world.

Server & UI

  • Nexus connect modal now correctly enables the map button and no longer squishes the map view.
  • Nexus map UI issues resolved, preventing the map from being distorted after recent changes.
  • Server listings now hide zone servers by default and expose Nexus info in A2S rules responses.
  • MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent adjustments.
  • General Nexus connect modal fixes improve stability when joining servers.

Items & Equipment

  • Medical honey bandage effects now fire properly, restoring the intended healing behavior.
  • Water bucket UI bug fixed: players can now transfer water into a held bucket without errors.

Vehicles

  • Resolved a pooling issue where runtime‑parented vehicle children caused null‑reference errors, improving vehicle spawn stability.
